fusions.name: Filament Binding
fusions.desc: A strike wound with fine root filaments that deals 4 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Needle Strands
fusions.desc: Combs out 4 strands of pine needles at once, spread apart, each dealing 6 damage. Holds 4 charges; kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Moss Mantle
fusions.desc: Mats moss and fibre into a barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Fine Draught
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once and heal you for 5% of your maximum health per stack (30% at full). Unfed, the stacks fade.
